name: Vedalken Plotter — Permanent A is a land you control, B a land an opponent controls; a pair the other way round exchanges nothing
notes: "When this creature enters, exchange control of target land you control and target land an opponent controls." (2026-10-18, with Spawnbroker.) The modal's A list holds only your lands and B only the opponent's (_exchangeControlSlotRules, read from the fire-time snapshot). A pair set with the opponent's Island as A is refused by the engine. Before, both lists held every land and any pair was exchanged.
